stackDivergence.rationale: Original source ownership and consumed native contracts are retained; host references, immutable XML/URI UTF16 fields and asynchronous ZIP transport bind browser execution around actual existing typed Any/OUString/PropertyValue owners.

local.marker: opens editable text after view settings, text effects and table row exceptions

preservedResponsibilities: The pinned native model and generator yield the original root, definition, attribute, resource and enumeration IDs for the consumed Word 2010 ligature and number format elements.
Generated native Word 2010 tables also select CT_StylisticSets, CT_StyleSet and the original scalar CT_OnOff with its attribute and start actions.

The generated Word 2010 factory recognizes text fill and outline and their native referenced definitions. The importer continues through their typed property contexts without requiring a drawing renderer.

The Word 2010 effect roots for glow, shadow, reflection, scene3d and props3d now use the original generated definitions and nested interoperability properties for DOCX run and style persistence through the browser Worker.
omittedResponsibilities: The consumed character typography uses the original three scalar effects. Other Word drawing effects and full Writer parity remain in progress.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Native Word 2010 factory data is emitted separately from its namespace singleton using the source-native model and generator.
